Established in **2021 in Spring, Texas**, SreeNarthana Natyalaya is a center dedicated to excellence in Bharatanatyam, blending tradition, discipline, and artistic refinement.

Under the distinguished guidance of **Smt. Sreenandini Jayaram**, we nurture more than dancers — we nurture artists grounded in technique, expressive depth, and cultural heritage. Our training instills discipline, confidence, and devotion, shaping performers who carry the timeless spirit of Bharatanatyam with poise and authenticity.
